contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]NVS PF AVG ; R/ SAL[VS AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), as kindly identified by the finder, Reece period 13, cf. Cunetio no. 2568. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [---]NVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Figure, possibly Salus, standing draped with transverse object before body, appearing like a wheatsheaf, and another object closer to horizontal, all over exergual line. Reverse inscription: SAL[VS AVG]. Diameter: 17.0mm, Weight: 2.06gms, die axis: 12
